messages:
Lin: Quick postmortem follow-up from today's multi-region failover rehearsal (13:00 UTC). Failover completed but we observed three repeatable gaps: route convergence tails, ambiguous restore steps, and deploy-time config drift. Dropping concise action items + snippets. Pls ack owners and adjust dates.

Raj: Saw ~15s tail on route convergence for a handful of prefixes. The traffic-swap script assumes near-zero propagation; we need a convergence metric + gating. Propose metric routing.converge_ms and a gating rule that requires p95 < 4s for 20s before final swap.

Tessa: During the restore test the operator paused because the runbook pointed to two different bucket paths. We need canonical backup naming and a sandboxed one-click restore with ephemeral creds. Also add an explicit "choose-restore-id" checklist item.

Diego: Noted config drift in Envoy pools after canary. CI didn't fail because label was optional. I'll make healthcheck label required and add a deploy guard that fails if any regional pool lacks it.

ops-bot: failover-rehearsal-2026-07-09: summary posted; follow-ups created INF-650, INF-651, INF-652.

Lin: Action items (short):
1) Routing convergence metric + gating
   - Owner: Raj
   - Due: 2026-07-22
   - Ticket: INF-650
   - Notes: emit histogram per-prefix, add Grafana panels, update traffic-swap to wait for gating.

2) Sandboxed one-click restore + canonical backup names
   - Owner: Tessa
   - Due: 2026-07-15
   - Ticket: INF-651
   - Notes: Jenkins job that creates ephemeral SA, restores into isolated namespace, runs app-level smoke tests, uploads verification artifact. Add 'restore-id' selection in runbook.

3) Envoy config schema + deploy guard
   - Owner: Diego
   - Due: 2026-07-12
   - Ticket: INF-652
   - Notes: make healthcheck label required in schema; fail deploy if missing; add small e2e to catch regression.

Lin: Minimal runbook preflight snippets to include under "preflight":

```
# list last backups
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/prod/ | tail -n 5
# checksum verify for candidate backup
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/prod/{{RESTORE_ID}} - | sha256sum
# sandbox restore (example)
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/key.json --iam-account=dr-sandbox@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/key.json
rdb restore --from s3://redwood-backups/prod/{{RESTORE_ID}} --to cluster=dr-sandbox --namespace=dr-test-$(date +%s) --verify
kubectl --context dr-sandbox -n dr-test-$(date +%s) run smoke --image=redwood/smoke:latest -- /bin/sh -c "curl -fsS http://app/health || exit 1"
```

Raj: ack. I'll add the metric and dashboard JSON to INF-650 and sketch the gating change for the traffic-swap script.

Tessa: ack. I'll prototype the Jenkins job and ensure key rotation/ephemeral creds are enforced. Will link INF-651 with demo logs.

Diego: ack. I'll open the schema PR and add the deploy guard as a pre-deploy check. Will attach tests to INF-652.

Lin: Two quick recurring-pattern notes: (a) config/label drift after rapid canaries has happened 4x in last 120 days; (b) two runs used shared creds by accident. These are systemic and are why the ticket set above is prioritized.

Lin: I'll update INF-650..INF-652 with owners/dates and schedule a 30m follow-up sync one week before the earliest due date. Closing thread; tickets hold details. If more items appear, drop them here and ops-bot will append. :white_check_mark:
